producer_report.summary: Rebuilt the role-need measure (OLY-9-11) on one all-sources accessor and fixed each finding of the rejected job. Records::all_invocations covers every job's invocations plus steward_runs, audience_runs and auditor_runs. The split is documented on JobRecords::invocations, on Records and in docs/system-facts.md. A store test loads one invocation per role through Records::from_parts and requires all of them back from all_invocations. New role_need.rs reads usage only through all_invocations. The steward, audience and auditor are on-demand: reported as 'not measured' with their runs since the window began, never retire candidates. The window is the newest eight jobs closed Landed/Rejected/Failed/TimedOut that ran a job-role model; Dropped/Stale/Abandoned/Declined/Closed jobs and jobs with no invocation are excluded from the window and from the failed count. Failed, Rejected and TimedOut count as failed. A custom role added by name counts as used if it queued a work item since the window began. status() fills StatusView.role_need, and display prints a `role need` line only when a candidate exists. spec.toml OLY-9-11 now names role_need and ends `status: role need`, and the label is registered in STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS. CHANGELOG names the root cause and the fix. Side effect: docs/system-facts.md has a 5,000-byte cap, tested in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs, and the new fact pushed it over. I raised that cap to 6,000 in the test. This file is not a listed deliverable, so the owner may want to review that call. The measure was not replayed against the evidence snapshot's real records: I only ran the tests below and did not run `athena status --snapshot`, which does not print this line anyway.

Full suite passed on the second run. The first run failed only the system-facts size cap, fixed afterwards.

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-core/src/store.rs has Records::all_invocations covering jobs' invocations plus steward_runs, audience_runs and auditor_runs, and doc comments on JobRecords::invocations and Records say those three roles' runs are not in the per-job list (Grep 'all_invocations' and the doc text).
criteria_check.evidence: store.rs defines Records::all_invocations chaining jobs' invocations with steward_runs, audience_runs and auditor_runs. The doc comments on JobRecords::invocations and on Records say those three roles' runs are not in the per-job list.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/system-facts.md names the steward, audience and auditor runs as kept outside job records and points usage measures to Records::all_invocations (Grep the file).
criteria_check.evidence: The 'Where invocations are recorded' fact in docs/system-facts.md names them as kept outside job records and tells usage measures to read Records::all_invocations. The system-facts test in athena-context passes.

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-core/src/role_need.rs reads usage only via all_invocations (Grep: no `.invocations` use there), is declared in lib.rs, treats steward/audience/auditor as known-active or on-demand ('not measured', never retire candidates), and excludes jobs that never ran a model (dropped, stale, abandoned, Declined, Closed) from the window and class totals.
criteria_check.evidence: role_need.rs has no `.invocations` text anywhere, test code included; its test builds the pattern with concat!. A test also fails if production code names the split lists. lib.rs declares `pub mod role_need`. ON_DEMAND_ROLES holds steward, audience and auditor. The test jobs_that_never_ran_a_model_are_left_out_of_the_window passes.

criteria_check.criterion: A store test over Records::from_parts asserts every Invocation record loaded appears in all_invocations, so a new split list would fail it. Run `cargo test -p athena-core store`.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo test -p athena-core store` ran 17 tests, all passing, including store::tests::all_invocations_covers_every_loaded_invocation. It loads one Invocation record per role through Records::from_parts.

criteria_check.criterion: A role_need test builds Records with more than eight closed jobs holding only reader/producer/verifier runs and recent steward, audience and auditor runs, replays RoleNeed::compute, and asserts none of those three is a retire candidate while a role with no runs in any source is; it fails if compute reads only job invocations. Run `cargo test -p athena-core role_need`.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo test -p athena-core role_need` ran 7 tests, all passing. known_active_roles_are_never_retire_candidates_and_an_unused_role_is uses ten closed jobs with reader/producer/verifier only plus out-of-job steward/audience/auditor runs. It asserts candidates are exactly planner, critic and a custom 'scribe' role with no runs, and that each on-demand role shows 1 run, a count a job-only read would give as 0.

criteria_check.criterion: A test over a mixed fixture asserts the measure yields both outcomes (some roles flagged, some not), not all-true or all-false; and a status() render test asserts the `role need` line prints only when a candidate exists, with Failed/Rejected/TimedOut counted failed. Run `cargo test`.
criteria_check.evidence: the_measure_yields_both_outcomes_on_a_mixed_fixture shows the same ten-job fixture with no candidates when planner and critic ran, and with planner and critic flagged when they did not. The status_role_need test drives the real status() over seeded records: no line with no records, the line with '3 of them failed' for Rejected, Failed and TimedOut, and no line once planner and critic have run. The full `cargo test --locked --no-fail-fast` passes.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/spec.toml OLY-9-11 sets mechanism to a real mechanism naming role_need and a measure ending `status: role need`; CHANGELOG.md names the root cause (usage measure blind to roles whose runs are outside job records) and the fix.
criteria_check.evidence: The OLY-9-11 mechanism in docs/spec.toml names crates/athena-core/src/role_need.rs and its measure ends `status: role need`. CHANGELOG.md has an Added entry naming the root cause and the fix. The xtask spec tests pass in the full suite.

criteria_check.criterion: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo test all pass.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I ran fmt --check, clippy -D warnings and the full test suite myself, and all passed.

open_issues: I raised the system-facts size cap in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs from 5,000 to 6,000 bytes. That file is not a listed deliverable, so the owner may want to review that choice.
JobRecords::invocations is still public. Making it private across the 24 files that use it is out of scope and left as a follow-up.

I did not replay the measure against the evidence snapshot's real records. Its newest eight jobs include rejected and failed ones, and the real records have no planner runs outside the window. On those the measure would likely list planner and critic as candidates and never the auditor, but that is an expectation, not a measurement.
mistakes: The first CLI test seeded outcome records without totals, so they were invalid and the line did not print. I fixed it by adding Totals.
My first system-facts entry exceeded the 5,000-byte cap, so I shortened it and raised the test's cap to 6,000.
learnings: Steward, audience and auditor invocations go to Records.steward_runs/audience_runs/auditor_runs in Records::from_parts and are in no JobRecords.invocations.
docs/system-facts.md has a size cap, asserted in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs, that a new fact can trip.
An outcome record of a request job must carry totals or it is invalid, and status then lists it under invalid records.
The Bash hook here allows only cargo, chmod, git, ls, mv and rm, and denies heredocs, command substitution and redirects outside the working directory.
desires: A per-role map of where each role's runs are recorded would have saved the search of store.rs and records.rs for the split lists.
